heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: Such sums as are necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter are hereby authorized to be appropriated.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This chapter, referred to in text, was in the original “this Act”, meaning Pub. L. 91–597, Dec. 29, 1970, 84 Stat. 1620, which is classified principally to this chapter. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 1031 of this title and Tables.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: For effective date of this section, see section 29 of Pub. L. 91–597, set out as a note under section 1031 of this title.
